How do we think about audience at Sci_Burst and as science communicators? 🤔💭🗣️

This is something Ella explores in her research paper with Will Grant all about conceptualising audience, that she also discussed at a recent Newswise online panel ‘Are you talking to ME?’ 

Link to Ella’s paper and her Newswise talk: https://linktr.ee/sci_burst 🌟🌟🌟
